ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus 'Operation DreamJob' / TraderTraitor — ISO+LNK script-engine spawn from Explorer with job-lure filename
ucs.description: Hunts the Lazarus initial-access chain where a victim mounts a recruiter-themed ISO/IMG/ZIP (LinkedIn / Skype outreach) and double-clicks a LNK that invokes wscript / cscript / mshta / rundll32 / powershell whose argument references the mounted container or a Lazarus lure keyword (Amazon_Assessment, BinanceUS, Lockheed, Boeing, Coinbase, Coupang, Job_Description). This parent=explorer + script-engine + lure-token combination is the signature Mandiant attributes to UNC4034 / Citrine Sleet / Labyrinth Chollima for both defence-aerospace and crypto-exchange targeting.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="explorer.exe" AND Processes.process_name IN ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","powershell.exe","cmd.exe") AND (Processes.process="*.iso*" OR Processes.process="*.img*" OR Processes.process="*.vhd*" OR Processes.process="*Amazon*Assessment*" OR Processes.process="*BinanceUS*" OR Processes.process="*Coinbase*" OR Processes.process="*Coupang*" OR Processes.process="*Lockheed*" OR Processes.process="*Boeing*" OR Processes.process="*Job*Description*" OR Processes.process="*Position*" OR Processes.process="*Salary*" OR Processes.process="*Offer*") by host, user, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.parent_process_id, Processes.process_name, Processes.process, Processes.process_id, Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user,"(?i).*\$$") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LazarusLures = dynamic(["amazon_assessment","amazon assessment","binanceus","coinbase","coupang","lockheed","boeing","airbus","general dynamics","raytheon","job_description","job description","position_","salary","offer_","compensation"]);
let ScriptEngines = dynamic(["wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "explorer.exe"
| where FileName in~ (ScriptEngines)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (".iso", ".img", ".vhd", ".zip")
      or ProcessCommandLine has_any (LazarusLures)
      or FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)\\Device\\CdRom"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath, ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ChildImage = FolderPath, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LazarusLures = dynamic(["amazon_assessment","amazon assessment","binanceus","coinbase","coupang","lockheed","boeing","airbus","general dynamics","raytheon","job_description","job description","position_","salary","offer_","compensation"]);
let ScriptEngines = dynamic(["wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\explorer.exe"
| extend ChildBin = tostring(split(NewProcessName,"\\")[-1])
| where ChildBin in~ (ScriptEngines)
| where CommandLine has_any (".iso", ".img", ".vhd", ".zip") or CommandLine has_any (LazarusLures)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Lazarus DreamJob ISO+LNK Script-Engine Spawn from Explorer
id: 7c4a3f9d-3b8a-4e2e-9c9d-1a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects an Explorer-spawned script engine (wscript/cscript/mshta/rundll32/powershell) whose command line references an ISO/IMG container or a Lazarus 'Operation DreamJob' / TraderTraitor lure keyword (Amazon_Assessment, BinanceUS, Coinbase, Lockheed, Boeing, Job_Description, etc.).
references:
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/mapping-dprk-groups-to-government
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2022/09/29/zinc-weaponizing-open-source-software/
  - https://blog.google/threat-analysis-group/new-campaign-targeting-security-researchers/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/31
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.005
  - attack.t1059.007
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.g0032
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_explorer:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\explorer.exe'
  child_script_engine:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
  lure_token:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '.iso'
      - '.img'
      - '.vhd'
      - 'Amazon_Assessment'
      - 'Amazon Assessment'
      - 'BinanceUS'
      - 'Coinbase'
      - 'Coupang'
      - 'Lockheed'
      - 'Boeing'
      - 'Job_Description'
      - 'Job Description'
      - 'Position_'
      - 'Salary'
      - 'Offer_'
  condition: parent_explorer and child_script_engine and lure_token
falsepositives:
  - Recruiters genuinely opening ISO-packaged job-description files (rare)
  - Sysadmins mounting ISOs containing PowerShell deployment scripts
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\explorer.exe OR *\\Explorer.exe OR *\\EXPLORER.EXE) @Image:(*\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CScript.exe OR *\\CSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RunDll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE) @CommandLine:(*.iso* OR *.img* OR *.vhd* OR *Amazon_Assessment* OR *Amazon\ Assessment* OR *BinanceUS* OR *Coinbase* OR *Coupang* OR *Lockheed* OR *Boeing* OR *Job_Description* OR *Job\ Description* OR *Position_* OR *Salary* OR *Offer_*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^explorer\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/\\(wscript|cscript|mshta|rundll32|powershell|pwsh|cmd)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(\\.iso|\\.img|\\.vhd|amazon[_ ]?assessment|binanceus|coinbase|coupang|lockheed|boeing|job[_ ]?description|position_|salary|offer_|compensation)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count())

ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus trojanized signed-app DLL side-loading with outbound C2 (3CX / AppleJeus / X_TRADER / TraderTraitor supply-chain pattern)
ucs.description: Hunts the Lazarus / Diamond Sleet supply-chain pattern where a legitimately code-signed third-party application that the group has trojanized (3CXDesktopApp.exe, Comm100.exe, X_TRADER.exe, putty.exe, AmazonAssistant.exe, BinanceUS.exe) loads a side-loaded DLL from a user-writable path and then initiates an outbound TCP/443 connection to a public IP within minutes. This loader → C2 chain is the load-bearing TTP of operations DreamJob (X_TRADER → VEILEDSIGNAL), 3CX (ffmpeg.dll → ICONICSTEALER / SUDDENICON), and AppleJeus (Celas Trade Pro variants).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.app IN ("3CXDesktopApp.exe","Comm100.exe","X_TRADER.exe","putty.exe","AmazonAssistant.exe","BinanceUS.exe","Amazon_Assessment.exe","TradingTechnologies.exe") AND All_Traffic.dest_category!="internal" AND All_Traffic.dest_port IN (80,443,8080,8443) by host, All_Traffic.app, All_Traffic.user, All_Traffic.process_id, All_Traffic.dest, All_Traffic.dest_ip, All_Traffic.dest_port | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | join type=inner host process_id [ | tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("3CXDesktopApp.exe","Comm100.exe","X_TRADER.exe","putty.exe","AmazonAssistant.exe","BinanceUS.exe","Amazon_Assessment.exe","TradingTechnologies.exe") by host, Processes.process_id, Processes.process_path, Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename process_path as binary_path ] | where NOT match(binary_path,"(?i)^C:\\\\Program Files") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LazarusSignedHosts = dynamic(["3cxdesktopapp.exe","comm100.exe","x_trader.exe","putty.exe","amazonassistant.exe","binanceus.exe","amazon_assessment.exe","tradingtechnologies.exe"]);
let KnownSideloadDlls = dynamic(["ffmpeg.dll","d3dcompiler_47.dll","wsock32.dll","msvcr100.dll","midlrtmd.dll","colorui.dll","libcurl.dll","secur32.dll"]);
let Loads = DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (LazarusSignedHosts)
    | where FileName in~ (KnownSideloadDlls)
         or FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)\\(AppData|ProgramData|Users\\Public|Temp)\\"
    | project LoadTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, HostBin = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              HostPid = InitiatingProcessId, DllName = FileName, DllPath = FolderPath,
              DllSHA256 = SHA256, Account = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
Loads
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (LazarusSignedHosts)
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, NetPid = InitiatingProcessId, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort
  ) on DeviceId
| where NetPid == HostPid and NetTime between (LoadTime .. LoadTime + 30m)
| project LoadTime, NetTime, DeviceName, Account, HostBin, DllName, DllPath, DllSHA256, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort
| order by LoadTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LazarusSignedHosts = dynamic(["3cxdesktopapp.exe","comm100.exe","x_trader.exe","putty.exe","amazonassistant.exe","binanceus.exe","amazon_assessment.exe","tradingtechnologies.exe"]);
let Hosts = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | extend Bin = tolower(tostring(split(TargetProcessName,"\\")[-1]))
    | where Bin in (LazarusSignedHosts)
    | where ActingProcessName !startswith @"C:\Program Files"
         or ActingProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(AppData|ProgramData|Users\\Public|Temp)\\"
    | project ProcTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, TargetProcessId, Bin, ProcCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine;
Hosts
| join kind=inner (
    ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where NetworkDirection == "Outbound" and DstPortNumber in (80,443,8080,8443)
    | where not(ipv4_is_private(DstIpAddr))
    | extend Bin = tolower(tostring(split(ActingProcessName,"\\")[-1]))
    | where Bin in (LazarusSignedHosts)
    | project NetTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, NetPid = ActingProcessId, Bin, DstIpAddr, DstHostname, DstPortNumber
  ) on DvcHostname, Bin
| where NetTime between (ProcTime .. ProcTime + 30m)
| project ProcTime, NetTime, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, Bin, ProcCmd, DstIpAddr, DstHostname, DstPortNumber
| order by ProcTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @Image:(*\\3CXDesktopApp.exe OR *\\3cxdesktopapp.exe OR *\\Comm100.exe OR *\\comm100.exe OR *\\X_TRADER.exe OR *\\x_trader.exe OR *\\putty.exe OR *\\PuTTY.exe OR *\\AmazonAssistant.exe OR *\\amazonassistant.exe OR *\\BinanceUS.exe OR *\\binanceus.exe OR *\\Amazon_Assessment.exe OR *\\TradingTechnologies.exe) AND NOT (CIDR(@DestinationIp, 10.0.0.0/8) OR CIDR(@DestinationIp, 172.16.0.0/12) OR CIDR(@DestinationIp, 192.168.0.0/16) OR CIDR(@DestinationIp, 127.0.0.0/8) OR CIDR(@DestinationIp, 169.254.0.0/16))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=NetworkConnectIP4 ContextImageFileName=/\\(3CXDesktopApp|Comm100|X_TRADER|putty|AmazonAssistant|BinanceUS|Amazon_Assessment|TradingTechnologies)\.exe$/i RemotePort=/^(80|443|8080|8443)$/
| NOT cidr("10.0.0.0/8", field=RemoteAddressIP4)
| NOT cidr("172.16.0.0/12", field=RemoteAddressIP4)
| NOT cidr("192.168.0.0/16", field=RemoteAddressIP4)
| NOT cidr("127.0.0.0/8", field=RemoteAddressIP4)
| join({#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(3CXDesktopApp|Comm100|X_TRADER|putty|AmazonAssistant|BinanceUS|Amazon_Assessment|TradingTechnologies)\.exe$/i | regex("(?i)\\\\(AppData|ProgramData|Users\\\\Public|Temp)\\\\", field=ImageFileName)}, field=aid)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, RemoteAddressIP4, RemotePort], function=count())
ucs.rationale: The signed-application allowlist is the Lazarus / Diamond Sleet uniqueness anchor — each binary in it has a publicly-documented Lazarus trojanization (3CXDesktopApp = Mandiant UNC4736 March 2023, X_TRADER = Symantec / Mandiant April 2023 VEILEDSIGNAL, Comm100 = CrowdStrike Sept 2022, AmazonAssistant/PuTTY = Mandiant UNC4034 / Operation DreamJob, BinanceUS/AppleJeus = CISA AA22-108A).
